gst.notes: GST remains 10% on most taxable supplies per current ATO guidance; confirm concessions or input-taxed treatments before lodging.

medicare.notes: Singles pay no levy below $28,011 (SAPTO $44,190). Families pay no levy below $47,253 (SAPTO $61,517) with an extra $4,335 per dependent child; thresholds taper in at 10% until the full 2% levy applies.

offsets.name: Low Income Tax Offset (LITO)
offsets.description: Up to $700 for incomes up to $37,500 in 2024-25, reducing progressively to nil at $66,667.

offsets.name: Low and Middle Income Tax Offset (LMITO)
offsets.description: Currently legislated as nil for 2024-25 and later. Retained for historical comparisons.

offsets.name: Senior Australians and Pensioners Tax Offset
offsets.description: Available subject to eligibility tests and income limits that vary by status. Refer to a tax agent for personalised assessment.

baseRateEntity.criteria: Aggregated turnover below $50 million and no more than 80% passive income.

failureToLodge.description: Failure to Lodge penalties accrue at one $364 penalty unit per 28 days (small entities, capped at 5 units). Medium entities pay double and large entities pay five times the base amount; remission depends on compliance history.

generalInterestCharge.description: General Interest Charge (GIC) accrues daily on outstanding tax debts and is no longer deductible for amounts incurred on or after 1 July 2025.

instantAssetWriteOff.eligibility: Aggregated turnover under $10 million and assets first used or installed ready for use within the eligible window.
instantAssetWriteOff.notes: Assets costing more than the threshold must be placed into the small business pool. Government has proposed making the $20,000 write-off permanent from 1 July 2026 (not yet law).

simplifiedDepreciation.eligibility: Available to small businesses using the simplified depreciation rules with aggregated turnover under $10 million.
simplifiedDepreciation.notes: When the closing pool balance falls below the instant asset write-off threshold it can be written off in full.

smallBusiness.reminder: Temporary $20,000 instant asset write-off ends 30 June 2025 unless extended by Parliament.

generalInterestCharge.description: General Interest Charge is applied using daily compounding interest. Rates change each quarter based on the 90-day bank bill rate plus a 7 percentage point uplift.

benchmarkInterest.description: Division 7A benchmark interest rate applies to shareholder or associate loans to avoid deemed dividends.
benchmarkInterest.frankingNotes: Use the benchmark rate to set minimum yearly repayments on complying Division 7A loans.

taxPlanning.disclaimer: These strategies are general information, not financial advice. Verify eligibility with the ATO or a registered tax agent.

strategies.title: Salary sacrifice into super
strategies.summary: Redirect pre-tax income into super to pay 15% contributions tax instead of your marginal rate.
actions: Check your concessional cap for the year
Set up salary sacrifice with payroll
Verify you are not over the Division 293 threshold of $250,000
strategies.caution: Exceeding the concessional cap attracts excess contributions tax.

strategies.title: Claim all work-related deductions
strategies.summary: Commonly missed: home office, vehicle, tools, protective clothing, self-education, and union fees.
actions: Keep receipts and a diary for 12 weeks of work travel
Claim the home office shortcut rate if eligible
Use the myDeductions app to log expenses year-round
strategies.caution: Deductions must be directly related to earning your income.

strategies.title: Instant asset write-off (small business)
strategies.summary: Deduct eligible assets costing under $20,000 immediately (extended to 30 June 2026).
actions: Identify assets under $20,000 first used this year
Place larger assets into the simplified depreciation pool
strategies.caution: Measure not yet law for post-30 June 2026 purchases.

strategies.title: Claim the Low Income Tax Offset (LITO)
strategies.summary: Taxpayers with taxable income under $66,667 may be entitled to up to $700 off their tax.
actions: Check eligibility via your tax return
Lodging your return automatically claims it

strategies.title: Negative gearing on investments
strategies.summary: Investment loan interest and costs can offset rental or business income.
actions: Track interest, insurance, rates, and maintenance
Claim capital works deductions where eligible
Keep records for 5 years after selling
strategies.caution: Seek advice - capital gains tax applies on sale.

strategies.title: Donate to registered charities
strategies.summary: Deductible Gift Recipients (DGR) donations over $2 are tax deductible.
actions: Confirm the charity holds DGR status
strategies.caution: Donations must be to endorsed DGRs, not crowdfunding appeals.
